Physical_Environment.Location: Laboratory, University of Aberdeen (ethics: Ethics Committee, School of Psychology, University of Aberdeen)

Equipment.Software: / (not disclosed in the paper; OSF archive holds only data files and stimuli)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (stimulus frequency: self-frequent, friend-frequent) x 2 (shape association: self, friend) x 2 (matching condition: matching, nonmatching), within-subjects; confirmatory context (instructed expectancies confirmed by actual frequencies)

Block_Structure.Block_number: 2 blocks of 200 trials each (one self-frequent 75/25, one friend-frequent 75/25; block order counterbalanced)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 400 trials per participant (per block: 100 matching + 100 nonmatching; 150 trials of the frequent shape - 75 matching + 75 nonmatching - and 50 of the infrequent shape - 25 matching + 25 nonmatching)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 10 (before the main task; not present in the data file)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: 100 ms (shape above and label below the fixation cross, presented together)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: none (blank screen until a response; response keys N and M, key-response mapping counterbalanced)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: triangle and square (138 x 138 pixels, white on grey background; shape-identity binding counterbalanced across participants and NOT recorded in the data - the Shape column holds identity words Self/Friend only)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: You and Friend (English words; NOT recorded in the data file - the Label column is derived from Trial Type + Shape Association, fully determined under the two-identity design)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 (confirmatory context): shape-label matching task (Sui et al. 2012) with stimulus-frequency expectancies. 24 participants (16 female, M age = 19.72, SD = 2.33), University of Aberdeen undergraduates; laboratory session. Task as in Exp 1, except that participants completed two blocks of 200 trials: one with a higher frequency of self-related shapes (75% self & 25% friend) and one with a higher frequency of friend-related shapes (75% friend & 25% self); block order counterbalanced; participants were reminded of the predominant shape before each block. Expectancies were confirmed by the actual frequencies. Data source: OSF cj7fp 'Experiment 2, confirmatory.xlsx' (8,335 rows; 24 participants). The author-provided file already excludes RT < 200 ms trials and non-response trials: RT min = 200 ms (paper analysis criterion, reported <2% of trials), no missing-value rows, RT ceiling ~1200 ms; per-subject trial counts range 215-390 of the 400 design trials - cause not documented by the authors; library keeps the file as-is (minimal preprocessing). Practice trials (10) are not in the file. File rows are ordered by block (Expectancy run: each participant has exactly two runs of ~200 rows, one per block; verified). Expectancy column = instructed block condition (Self/Friend), which coincides with the actual stimulus frequency in this confirmatory design (verified: self-expectancy blocks contain 74.7% self-associated shapes, friend-expectancy blocks 74.6% friend-associated). No Target Label column in the file: the Label column is derived from Trial Type + Shape Association (Matching -> label = shape identity; Nonmatching -> label = the other identity; fully determined with two identities; user decision 2026-09). No geometric shape information (binding counterbalanced, not recorded) - Shape column holds identity words. No demographics in the data; paper reports 16 female / M age 19.72 (2.33) - subj_info rows carry '/'. Descriptive direction checks (mean of per-subject means, correct RTs): self-expectancy blocks self 604.3 ms / 86.7% vs friend 695.3 ms / 62.0%; friend-expectancy blocks friend 604.8 ms / 80.2% vs self 655.8 ms / 72.0% - frequent stimuli prioritized, more so for self - consistent with the paper's Fig. 3-4. numTrials = 400; numBlocks = 2; Practice_Trial = 10; Practice_Block = 1; Setting = Laboratory; Software not disclosed (Environmental_Info left empty per P18). Library products: raw 8,335 rows (author columns verbatim), Clean 15 columns (incl. derived Block and Expectancy), subj_info 24 rows (demographics '/').
